question: Does the existing four-part selector preserve complete model behaviour and earn deterministic-greedy opt-in use over the existing PARTS0 selector?

relationship_to_prior_gate.original_default_PARTS0_gate: Unchanged and historically passing; this is a separate prospective question, not relabelling or replacing it

scope.model: Original registered pick_e1_L16 exact model and eval100 requests
scope.KV: Default f32, no E9 f16 override
scope.reason_default_ineligible: PARTS4 explicitly requires EMBER_DETERMINISTIC=1 and must not silently enable that mode. A passing diagnostic cannot broaden this contract.

correctness.inventory: Original complete registered request and row inventory; assert exact shapes/counts before comparison
correctness.required: Complete finite logit row bits, prompt IDs, selected IDs, replies, stop reasons and token counts equal across repeats and arms; original fallback/capture/scratch tests retained
correctness.control_failure: Missing or invalid host/control evidence, incomplete inventories, or source/input/hardware/config failures are operationally inconclusive. Candidate-only nonfinite output with valid controls is a correctness failure.

performance.storage: Uniform local scratch across all timing arms; row dumps disabled for timing; bind complete separate row evidence
performance.warmup_and_request_procedure: Use unchanged registered R1 collector procedure and validity predicates, version/hash-bound when the collector is prepared
eligibility_predicates: Each of the two individual parts4/host throughput ratios is at least1.15
Each of the two individual parts4/parts0 throughput ratios is at least1.0
All correctness/repeat/source/request/capture validity predicates pass; no pooling can rescue a failed pair
Validated actual dispatch evidence proves each requested arm; no silent PARTS4 fallback
performance.threshold_rationale: Retain the existing1.15 compact-selector eligibility hurdle against the host path, and require no observed regression versus the already-passing PARTS0 path in either order-balanced pair. This is a conservative engineering eligibility decision for added integration complexity, not a statistical proof of general speed superiority.
performance.uncertainty: Two pairs do not establish a population confidence bound or a speed plateau. Report both raw ratios and timings. A failed eligibility predicate does not prove general inferiority; uncertain performance can remain scientifically inconclusive while opt-in adoption is rejected.

stopping.endpoint: Exactly the complete prespecified six row legs and two ordered timing triples; no automatic extra repeats after seeing results
stopping.pass: Supports only tested deterministic-greedy model-specific opt-in eligibility; no automatic global/default enablement
stopping.operational_failure: Preserve partial evidence; require diagnosed repair or a discriminating separately versioned diagnostic before retry
stopping.reopen: A substantive candidate/configuration change or decision-relevant unresolved mechanism with a prospective protocol; not a desire to obtain a pass
stopping.correctness_or_repeatability_failure: Preserve evidence and reject/disable this candidate from supported opt-in use until a reviewed repair passes a new prospective gate. Candidate-only nonfinite output with valid controls is included.
stopping.performance_only_miss_or_uncertainty: Preserve evidence. A correctness-passing candidate may remain experimental, without adoption or claims of general inferiority; no tuning source, threshold or subset within this run.

requirements: Separate reviewed collector/checker packet, frozen before outcomes
Existing serial GPU queue, fresh financial cap/deadline/owner probe and watchdog
Complete safe home replay and resource cleanup

candidate_source_role: Design basis only. Any dispatch-observability patch requires separate review and a new frozen source pin before collection.

dispatch_evidence.required: Prove the actual dispatch route for every arm using validated per-arm counters, logs or equivalent evidence; requested flags alone are insufficient. Inventory every fallback and refusal.
dispatch_evidence.preparation: No existing dispatch observability is presumed sufficient. Review any required instrumentation patch separately and re-pin source before freezing the collector.
dispatch_evidence.timing: Use dedicated untimed route-proof legs and establish equivalence to timing configuration. Disable tracing during timing and disclose instrumentation overhead. Do not change numerical operations to collect evidence.
dispatch_evidence.missing_proof: Inconclusive and ineligible for adoption, even if numerical and timing comparisons pass.
minimum_inventory: Per request/token, distinguish prefill from eligible sampled decode positions
Record requested arm, effective partition count, graph capture/replay and per-launch fallback separately
Account for API eligibility exclusions: IR, CPU offload, non-greedy sampling and repetition penalties
Distinguish compact pick execution from host-row selection after near ties, nonfinite records or debug row capture
Prove selector execution on CUDA graph replay, not only graph capture; graph construction counters alone are insufficient
Tie route evidence and timing arms to the same source/input/configuration; record intended debug-row-induced host fallback rather than treating it as normal compact consumption
